description: Agent Commitments: submit an agent’s open commitments with their deadlines and the work left: the capacity with the date the plan is read on and the hours a day the agent gives its commitments (6 when left out); and each commitment with its id, the commitment, the promisee, the date it is due and the hours of work left on it. The signed report gives the capacity with the hours needed, every commitment with its working days and hours available by its date and its status as feasible, impossible, stacked, tight, past_due, finished or unconfirmed, and the load by each due date with the commitments due by then, the hours needed and available, the shortfall and the slack, and names an agent that has promised more than it can deliver on time: deadlines the work left cannot fit on their own, and stacks of commitments that fit one by one but not together by some date; then stacks with under 15% of their hours to spare and commitments already past their date with work left, with the fix for each. This tests the agent’s own deadlines against its own remaining work: the dates and obligations in one document are wever_deadline-check, and one resource committed twice by collaborators is wever_coordination-conflict-check. Verdict deadlines_overcommitted, deadline_feasibility_gaps, deadline_feasibility_unverified or deadlines_feasible. POST /api/commitment-deadline-check. Reads only the recorded promises and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no promise is made, changed or closed and no promisee is contacted. Agent Commitments reads the promises an agent makes itself, from capture to closure: it is not delegation (assigning work and authority to another agent, the wever_delegation checks; a commitment is the agent’s own promise, whoever ends up doing the work), not coordination (how agents organize shared work, the wever_coordination checks), not reputation (the durable standing a track record earns, the wever_reputation checks; commitments are the individual promises that record is built from), not the loop on feedback received (wever_feedback-closure-check; this family closes the agent’s own promises) and not who answers for an outcome (wever_ownership-map-brief; this family tracks the promise itself). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-commitments-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-commitments/.

as_of.description: The date the plan is read on.

hours_per_day.description: Hours a day the agent gives its commitments; 6 when left out.

commitments.description: Each open commitment with its deadline and the work left.

due.description: When it is due, as a date.

hours_remaining.description: Hours of work left on it.

id.description: The commitment id, such as c1.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
